title: festuca communis var. rubra
intro: Festuca communis var. rubra, commonly known as Red Fescue, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety, insomnia, and restlessness due to its sedative and anxiolytic effects. The health benefits of Red Fescue include its ability to promote relaxation, reduce muscle spasms, and aid in the treatment of menstrual disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include coumarins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of sedation, anxiolysis, and spasmolytic effects.
